SUPPORTED NOW

Focused checks.
Honest coverage.

  • Content Security Policy
  • HTTPS / HSTS policy
  • Content type & frame protections
  • Cookie security attributes
  • Cross-origin configuration
  • Private key & access key patterns

This analyzes what you import. It does not crawl the URL or test SQL injection, XSS execution, or account access.
